entities.summary: Jerzy Rybicki is a retired boxer from Poland, who represented his country at the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montréal, Quebec, Canada. There he won the gold medal in the light middleweight division, after having defeated Yugoslavia's Tadija Kačar in the final.
